---
# DO NOT CHANGE ANYHTING IN YAML (FOR NOW!)
# NOTE: 
# When clicking Knit, RStudio may display a "Run Custom Render Command?" warning.
# This is expected. Simply click "Yes" to generate the PDF. :)
knit: (function(inputFile, encoding) statwise::pdf_report_setup(inputFile))
title: "Temporary Title"
author: ""
date: ""

header-includes:
    # Allows to add header and footer...............................................................
  - \usepackage{fancyhdr}
    # So that all pages have header and footer (opposed to {plain}).................................
  - \pagestyle{fancy}
    # what to input to the left and right sides of header...........................................
  - \fancyhead[LE,RO]{`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y')`}
  - \fancyhead[RE,LO]{Organization's Name}
    # by default the cover page gets header and footer styling, to remove them......................
  - \thispagestyle{empty}
    # seems like when kbl() is a "logntable", its caption does not automatically stretch to full width
    # to fix this issue: use caption package........................................................
  - \usepackage{caption}
    # to begin page numbering from the nth page.....................................................
    # add \pagenumbering{arabic} after the \newpage of the nth page and use \pagenumbering{gobble}
  - \pagenumbering{gobble}
    # assign color to headings......................................................................
  - \usepackage{xcolor}
  - \usepackage{sectsty}
  - \sectionfont{\color[HTML]{2a2a2a}} # this is the color that MS word uses for headdings
  - \subsectionfont{\color[HTML]{2a2a2a}}
  - \subsubsectionfont{\color[HTML]{2a2a2a}}
    # this forces captions to go above figures and tables...........................................
  - \usepackage{floatrow}
  - \floatsetup[figure]{capposition=top}
  - \floatsetup[table]{capposition=top}
  - \usepackage{setspace}
  - \setstretch{1.1}




output: 
  pdf_document:
      latex_engine: xelatex
      toc: true
      toc_depth: 4
      fig_caption: yes
fontsize: 12pt
mainfont: "TeX Gyre Termes"
sansfont: "TeX Gyre Heros"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  message    = FALSE,
  error      = FALSE,
  fig.align  = "center",
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6.5,
  out.width  = "90%",
  dpi        = 120
)

```

```{r libraries}
library(statwise)
statwise::clear_env()
```

)

)
